summary: The test now snapshots the managed client record and its managed_client_audit entries before registering the client, and the finally block deletes all test-written audits, restores the snapshot, and restores or deletes the client record, so consecutive runs leave no test-owned registration behind.

evidence: src/handler_test.ts lines 1762-1768 capture clientKey and snapshot previousClient plus all managed_client_audit entries before createManagedClient writes the test registration.
src/handler_test.ts lines 2165-2172 delete every managed_client_audit entry under the test client prefix, restore the snapshot, then restore or delete clientKey.
This removes the leftover backblaze-google-photos registration that previously made createManagedClient return null on the next run, while preserving any pre-existing managed client and audit state.
